multisportSet.description:
If the value is in the closed range 0-99, then a multisport transition reset should be performed in between the legs (record a multisport activity).
 If the value is in the closed range 100-254, then the legs (sessions) should be performed as separate workouts (2 separate activities but still back-to-back).
 If the value is 255 - the workouts were not intended to be grouped (2 separate activities recorded some time on the same day, but not necessarily back to back)

BodyBatteryV2DTO.description: Contains information about body battery. All values are given on a scale 5 to 100. The term "endOfDay" in this object refers to the last value before the user's sleep period; in other words, the value at the end of their "waking day", not the "calendar day".

chargedValue.description: Increase in Body Battery over the day.

drainedValue.description: Decrease in Body Battery over the day.

endOfDayValue.description: Latest Body Battery value prior to sleep.

featureVersion.description: The Body Battery feature version for the user's device.

maxValue.description: Maximum Body Battery value for the day.

minValue.description: Minimum Body Battery value for the day.

bodyBatteryValueDescriptorIndex.description: Column index into each row of bodyBatteryValuesArray that this descriptor describes.

bodyBatteryValueDescriptorKey.description: Name of the column described by this descriptor: timestamp, bodyBatteryLevel, bodyBatteryStatus, or bodyBatteryVersion.

CalendarEventInfoDTO.description: Completion target and personalized goal associated with the activity's linked calendar event. Each value is paired with a unit type indicating distance or time. For multisport events, these values may describe an individual leg or transition.

completionTargetUnitType.description: Type of completion target: distance indicates completionTargetValue is in meters; time indicates it is in seconds.

completionTargetValue.description: Completion target for the linked calendar event, in meters when completionTargetUnitType is distance or seconds when it is time.

customGoalUnitType.description: Type of user entered goal: distance indicates customGoalValue is in meters; time indicates it is in seconds.

customGoalValue.description: User entered goal for the linked calendar event, in meters when customGoalUnitType is distance or seconds when it is time.

CaloriesV2DTO.description: Contains information about calories burned and consumed.

burnedActive.description: Active calories burned for the day.

burnedResting.description: Basal metabolic rate (BMR) calories burned for the day.

burnedTotal.description: Total calories burned for the day.

consumedGoal.description: User goal for daily consumed calories (this can change day-to-day).

consumedRemaining.description: Remaining calories the user should consume to reach their goal for the day, adjusted upwards for any burned active calories (e.g.: `consumedGoal` - `consumedValue` + `burnedActive`). If negative, the user has already exceeded their goal.

localDate.description: User-local calendar date corresponding to the timestamp.

CycleTypeAnalysisDTO.description: Analysis of the user's menstrual cycle type

cycleLengthDeviationDays.description: Number of days the cycle length deviates from the user's median cycle length.

cycleType.description: The classified type of the cycle.

cycleVariability.description: A measure of how much the user's cycle lengths vary across recent cycles.

cycleVariabilityClassifier.description: A classifier label describing the level of cycle variability.

hasAmenorrhea.description: Indicates whether amenorrhea (absence of menstruation) was detected.

lutealLengthDeviationDays.description: Number of days the luteal phase length deviates from the user's typical length.

medianCycleLength.description: The user's median cycle length, in days, calculated from recent cycle history.

medianCycleLengthClassifier.description: A classifier label describing the median cycle length.

periodLengthDeviationDays.description: Number of days the period length deviates from the user's typical period length.

prolongedPeriods.description: Number of recent periods classified as prolonged.

prolongedPeriodsClassifier.description: A classifier label describing whether the user tends to have prolonged periods.

abnormalHRValuesArray.description: Raw heart rate readings flagged as abnormal (above/below the configured thresholds).

notes.description: Free-text notes entered by the user for this day.

ovulationDay.description: Indicates whether this day was marked/predicted as the ovulation day.

sexDrive.description: The sex drive level logged for this day.

sexualActivity.description: The sexual activity type logged for this day.

symptoms.description: List of symptoms logged for this day.

napEndTimestampGMT.description: End of the nap, in UTC.

napStartTimeOffset.description: Timezone offset from UTC in minutes.

napStartTimestampGMT.description: Start of the nap, in UTC.

allWeightMetrics.description: All weight measurements recorded for this date.

DiveGasDTO.description: Gas mixture and associated tank information for a dive. Includes gas composition and configuration recorded by the dive computer, plus manually entered volume, tank, pressure, and consumption details when available.

gasIndex.description: Zero-based index identifying the gas in the dive gas list. Index 0 represents the bottom gas.

gasMode.description: Dive gas mode code: 0 for open circuit or 1 for closed-circuit diluent.

heliumContent.description: Helium content of the gas mixture, expressed as a percentage.

oxygenContent.description: Oxygen content of the gas mixture, expressed as a percentage.

sacRate.description: Surface air consumption (SAC) rate associated with the gas.

status.description: Dive gas status code: 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled or 2 for backup only.

tankEndingPressure.description: Tank pressure at the end of the dive, expressed in the unit identified by tankEndingPressureUnit.unitKey.

tankEndingPressureUnit.description: Unit for tankEndingPressure, such as bar or psi.

tankSize.description: Tank size, expressed in the unit identified by tankSizeUnit.unitKey.

tankSizeUnit.description: Unit for tankSize, such as liter or cubicfoot.

tankStartingPressure.description: Tank pressure at the start of the dive, expressed in the unit identified by tankStartingPressureUnit.

tankStartingPressureUnit.description: Unit for tankStartingPressure, such as bar or psi.

tankType.description: User-entered tank material or type, such as steel, aluminum, or other.

volume.description: Manually entered gas volume, expressed in the unit identified by volumeUnit.unitKey. This field is not supplied by the device's dive gas message.

volumeUnit.description: Unit for volume, such as liter or cubicfoot.

DiveInfoDTO.description: Dive-specific information combining data recorded by the dive computer with user-entered details about equipment, conditions, and dive buddies.

buddy.description: User-entered name or description of the dive buddy or buddies.

current.description: User-entered description of the water current during the dive.

diveGases.description: Gas mixture and tank information associated with the dive.

diveSettings.description: Dive computer settings associated with the activity, including decompression model, water properties, and closed-circuit rebreather setpoints when available.

entryType.description: User-entered method or location of entry into the water.

equipments.description: User-entered equipment details for the dive, returned as a single string rather than an array.

exposureSuit.description: User-entered type or description of the exposure suit worn during the dive.

surfaceCondition.description: User-entered description of water conditions at the surface.

totalSurfaceTime.description: Total surface interval time, in seconds, accumulated from the dive summaries associated with the activity.

visibility.description: Underwater visibility distance, expressed in the unit identified by visibilityUnit.unitKey.

visibilityUnit.description: Unit for visibility, such as meter or foot.

weight.description: Weight used for the dive, expressed in the unit identified by weightUnit.unitKey.

weightUnit.description: Unit for weight, such as kilogram or pound.

DiveSettingsDTO.description: Dive computer settings associated with the activity. Model, water type, and setpoint switch modes use numeric codes. Closed-circuit rebreather (CCR) fields describe oxygen partial pressure (PO2) setpoints and their switching behavior.

ccrHighSetpoint.description: Target oxygen partial pressure (PO2) for the CCR high setpoint, as recorded by the dive computer.

ccrHighSetpointDepth.description: Depth, in meters, at which the dive computer switches to the CCR high setpoint when automatic switching is enabled.

ccrHighSetpointSwitchMode.description: Switching mode for the CCR high oxygen partial pressure setpoint: 0 for manual or 1 for automatic

ccrLowSetpoint.description: Target oxygen partial pressure (PO2) for the CCR low setpoint, as recorded by the dive computer.

ccrLowSetpointDepth.description: Depth, in meters, at which the dive computer switches to the CCR low setpoint when automatic switching is enabled.

ccrLowSetpointSwitchMode.description: Switching mode for the CCR low oxygen partial pressure setpoint: 0 for manual or 1 for automatic.

gfHigh.description: High gradient factor used to control decompression conservatism, expressed as a percentage.

gfLow.description: Low gradient factor used to control decompression conservatism, expressed as a percentage.

model.description: Tissue model code used for decompression calculations; 0 identifies ZHL_16C.

name.description: Name of the dive settings profile.

waterDensity.description: Water density, in kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m^3). Typical values are 1000 for fresh water and 1025 for salt water; a custom water type permits a custom density.

waterType.description: Water type code: 0 for fresh water, 1 for salt water, 2 for the EN13319 reference or 3 for custom density

EBikeAssistModeInfoDTO.description: Maps an e-bike assist mode identifier to its name, as reported in an assist mode information message recorded during the activity.

ebikeAssistMode.description: Numeric e-bike assist mode identifier. Use ebikeAssistModeName for the corresponding name.

ebikeAssistModeName.description: E-bike assist mode name corresponding to ebikeAssistMode. Illustrative names include Eco, Tour, Sport, and Turbo; actual names depend on the e-bike and are not a fixed set.

typeId.description: Identifier of the event classification associated with the activity

typeKey.description: Key identifying the event classification associated with the activity, such as race, training, recreation, fitness, specialEvent, or uncategorized

improvementValue.description: The difference between the current value and the target value.

lastMeasurementDate.description: Last date when the component was measured.

numOfWeeksForIm.description: Number of weeks of Intensity Minutes data that was used to calculate Vigorous Days or Vigorous Weeks component.

potentialAge.description: Potential Fitness Age if the user were to achieve the target value for this component.

priority.description: The relative priority of this component.

stale.description: Whether the data in this component is considered stale. Stale data means it has not been updated recently and may not reflect the user's current state.

targetValue.description: The target value of the component that would result in the best possible Fitness Age.

value.description: The current value of the component.

achievableFitnessAge.description: The achievable Fitness Age for the user.

components.description: Details on the components that contributed to the user's Fitness Age. Components include Vigorous Days, Vigorous Minutes, Resting Heart Rate, BMI/Body Fat Percentage.

invalidReason.description: If there is no Fitness Age available, the reason why it is missing will be provided.

lastUpdated.description: The timestamp when the Fitness Age information was last updated.

previousFitnessAge.description: Previous Fitness Age for the user.

moderate.description: Moderate intensity minutes for the day.

LocalTime.description: The ending time of the period this meal occupies every day. Some meals might not have set time periods, so this value may be null. customMealId.description: Custom Meal Id associated (if any) with the food.

foodImages.description: Partner-provided food images in various sizes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the custom meal item

isFavorite.description: Whether the food is favorited by the user.

logCategory.description: Category of the log event, representing the type of food log action. Possible values: REGULAR_LOG, QUICK_ADD, IMAGE_RECOGNITION, BARCODE etc.

logId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the food log this event belongs to.

logTimestamp.description: Timestamp for the initiation/firing of this event; always given as an ISO-8601 timestamp and in the UTC timezone. This timestamp does not need to match the mealDate for this event, as users can update food logs for past and future dates.

mealDateTimeWithOffset.description: Time (with date and timezone offset) user picked when user logged the food.

mealId.description: ID of the meal for which this food was logged.

mealTime.description: Time (just to the hour as of now) user picked when user logged the food.

servingQty.description:
The number of servings being added/removed.

This is NOT the serving size; the given food in each event represents a single serving, regardless of how that serving is defined/measured for that specific food. This field is simply a multiplier to the nutrition content of that serving.

type.description: Type of consumable; FOOD or RECIPE

MealDTO.description: Defines a meal (e.g.: breakfast, lunch, dinner, etc.).

defaultMealName.description: This is the default name for each meal. Some meals might have their name changed, this allows you to get it's original name.This will ONLY be populated for the GET meals/{date}, PUT meals/{date}, GET meals/range, and GET metadata endpoint

displayOrder.description: Used to define sort ordering for meal lists; lower numbers will appear earlier, with ties being resolved by sorting alphabetically using the mealName. Meals with no sortIndex will be shown last.

mealIndex.description: The index of this meal within the complete list of meals belonging to the current user. The index should remain the same over the lifespan of the meal, and this value should be unique across meals belonging to one user. For default meals, this value will be 1 for BREAKFAST, 2 for LUNCH, 3 for DINNER, and 4 for SNACKS. WorkoutStepDTO.description: An individual step or repeat instruction in the activity's structured workout. Describes when the step ends, its training target, and optional exercise details. Numeric duration and target values must be interpreted together with their type identifiers.

durationType.description: Condition that ends the step, such as TIME, DISTANCE, REPS, HR_LESS_THAN, HR_GREATER_THAN, OPEN for no fixed duration, and REPEAT_UNTIL_STEPS_CMPLT for a repeat group.

durationValue.description: Value for the step's end condition: seconds for TIME, meters for DISTANCE, or repetition count for REPS. For repeat instructions, this is the stepIndex to return to, not elapsed time. Heart-rate thresholds use percentage of maximum heart rate or bpm + 100; power thresholds use percentage of functional threshold power (FTP) or watts + 1000.

equipmentType.description: Equipment associated with the step, returned as an uppercase identifier such as NONE, SWIM_FINS, SWIM_KICKBOARD, or SWIM_PULL_BUOY.

exerciseCategory.description: Exercise category associated with the step, returned as an uppercase identifier such as BENCH_PRESS. Used with exerciseName to identify a specific exercise.

exerciseName.description: Specific exercise within exerciseCategory, returned as an uppercase identifier rather than localized display text.

exerciseWeightValue.description: Exercise weight, in kilograms, when available. The numeric value remains in kilograms regardless of weightDisplayUnit.

intensity.description: Role or effort classification of the step, such as ACTIVE, WARMUP, COOLDOWN, REST, or RECOVERY.

name.description: Name of the workout step, when supplied. May be null or blank.

notes.description: Free-text instructions or notes associated with the step.

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index identifying the step within the workout. Repeat instructions use these indices to identify the step to return to.

targetType.description: Training target for the step, returned as an uppercase identifier such as HEART_RATE, SPEED, CADENCE, POWER, or SWIM_STROKE. OPEN indicates no specific target. Repeat instructions are interpreted using durationType instead.

targetValue.description: Target selector whose meaning depends on the step type. For speed, heart-rate, cadence, or power zones, 0 selects a custom range defined by targetValueLow and targetValueHigh; a nonzero value selects a zone. For REPEAT_UNTIL_STEPS_CMPLT, this is the repeat count; other repeat types use it as their stopping threshold, such as seconds for REPEAT_UNTIL_TIME or meters for REPEAT_UNTIL_DISTANCE.

targetValueHigh.description: Upper bound of a custom target range, using the same units and encoding as targetValueLow. For a heart-rate target, 270 represents 170 bpm.

targetValueLow.description: Lower bound of a custom target range. Speed is in meters per second. Heart rate uses percentage of maximum heart rate or bpm + 100 (250 means 150 bpm). Power uses percentage of FTP or watts + 1000. Cadence is in revolutions per minute, or steps per minute for running workouts.

weightDisplayUnit.description: Preferred unit for displaying exerciseWeightValue, returned as an uppercase identifier such as KILOGRAM or POUND. Does not change the unit of the returned numeric weight.
